import time
from perf import common_elements, fib, count_pairs, dedupe_keep_order

def test_correctness():
    # Test common_elements
    assert common_elements([1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4]) == [2, 3]
    assert common_elements([1, 1, 2], [1, 3]) == [1]
    assert common_elements([], [1, 2]) == []
    
    # Test fib
    assert fib(0) == 0
    assert fib(1) == 1
    assert fib(5) == 5
    assert fib(10) == 55

    # Test count_pairs
    assert count_pairs([1, 2, 3, 4, 3], 6) == 2  # (2,4), (3,3) - wait index pairs i<j.
    # Pairs are: nums[1]+nums[3] = 2+4=6, nums[2]+nums[4] = 3+3=6. Yes.
    assert count_pairs([1, 1, 1], 2) == 3 # (0,1), (0,2), (1,2)
    assert count_pairs([1, 2, 3], 10) == 0

    # Test dedupe_keep_order
    assert dedupe_keep_order([1, 2, 2, 3, 1, 4]) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
    assert dedupe_keep_order([]) == []
    assert dedupe_keep_order([1, 1, 1]) == [1]

    print("Correctness tests passed!")

def test_performance():
    print("Starting performance tests...")
    
    # Test common_elements performance
    a = list(range(200000))
    b = list(range(100000, 300000))
    start = time.time()
    res = common_elements(a, b)
    duration = time.time() - start
    print(f"common_elements: {duration:.4f}s")
    assert duration < 2

    # Test fib performance
    start = time.time()
    res = fib(300)
    duration = time.                time.time() - start
    print(f"fib(300): {duration:.4f}s")
    assert duration < 2

    # Test count_pairs performance
    nums = list(range(100000))
    target = 99999
    start = time.time()
    res = count_pairs(nums, target)
    duration = time.time() - start
    print(f"count_pairs: {duration:.4f}s")
    assert duration < 2

    # Test dedupe_keep_order performance
    items = list(range(200000)) + [i for i in range(1000, -1, -1)]
    start = time.time()
    res = dedupe_keep_order(items)
    duration = time.time() - start
    print(f"dedupe_keep_order: {duration:.4f}s")
    assert duration < 2

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_correctness()
    test_performance()
